title: The Carousel Lens III: Joint lens convergence and source kinematic modeling
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables, submitted to the Open Journal of Astrophysics
summary: We introduce a new, independent modeling component to the Carousel Lens series by exploiting the spatially-resolved kinematics contained within the lensed arcs, which so far has remained rather underexplored in strong-lensing analyses. We present an end-to-end forward-modeling framework that reconstructs an integral-field spectroscopic datacube from a parameterization of the lens convergence profile together with the line-of-sight velocity, velocity dispersion, and surface brightness profiles of the unlensed source. The kinematic structure of the source acts as an additional set of ray-traceable markers distributed across every lensed image, inaccessible from imaging data alone. Furthermore, by generating an [OII] emission-line datacube, we isolate a single source redshift and remove lens and line-of-sight light contamination. We apply this framework to deep VLT/MUSE observations of the Carousel Lens, modeling the [OII] emission of the quadruply-imaged star-forming galaxy at $z_{\rm s} = 1.432$ that anchors the system's cosmography constraints. We measure an Einstein radius $θ_{\rm E} = 12.816''^{+0.005}_{-0.007}$ and a logarithmic slope $γ= 1.412^{+0.002}_{-0.002}$, tightening the statistical uncertainties on both by roughly a factor of $2-2.5$ relative to the corresponding flat emission-line map model. We find that the source galaxy exhibits a strong rotation, lies confidently along the star-forming main sequence, and has an inferred central black hole mass of $\log M_{\rm BH}/M_{\odot} = 7.89 \pm 0.51$. These results establish datacube-level forward modeling as a practical and independent route to traditional image-based lens models in the current systematics-limited regime, and one that extends naturally to this system's other lensed sources and to other lens systems.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们通过利用透镜弧内包含的空间分辨运动学信息，为旋转木马透镜系列引入了一个新的、独立的建模组件，这在强透镜分析中迄今尚未得到充分探索。我们提出了一个端到端的前向建模框架，该框架从透镜收敛轮廓的参数化以及未透镜源沿视线速度、速度弥散和表面亮度轮廓出发，重建积分场光谱数据立方。源的运动学结构作为一组额外的可光线追踪标记，分布在每个透镜图像中，这是仅凭成像数据无法获得的。此外，通过生成[OII]发射线数据立方，我们分离出单一源红移，并去除透镜和视线光污染。我们将此框架应用于旋转木马透镜的深度VLT/MUSE观测，对锚定该系统宇宙学约束的四重成像恒星形成星系在$z_{\rm s} = 1.432$处的[OII]发射进行建模。我们测得爱因斯坦半径$θ_{\rm E} = 12.816''^{+0.005}_{-0.007}$和对数斜率$γ= 1.412^{+0.002}_{-0.002}$，相对于相应的平坦发射线图模型，两者的统计不确定性均收紧约$2-2.5$倍。我们发现源星系表现出强旋转，确信位于恒星形成主序上，并推断其中心黑洞质量为$\log M_{\rm BH}/M_{\odot} = 7.89 \pm 0.51$。这些结果确立了数据立方级前向建模作为当前系统误差限制区域中传统基于图像的透镜模型的一种实用且独立的途径，并且该途径自然可扩展到该系统的其他透镜源以及其他透镜系统。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 数据立方级前向建模可作为独立于传统图像透镜模型的实用路径，并自然推广至该系统其他透镜源及其他透镜系统。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: VLT/MUSE images of the Carousel Lens. Left: the full whitelight image, generated by aggregating the datacube along its spectral axis. The most-prominent galaxy-cluster members are labeled here, with \(L_{e}\) lying outside the image cutout. This is similar to what is typically observed with imaging data. Right: by focusing on the [O II ] emission at \(z_{s}=1.432\) and leveraging the continuum of the other sources in frame, we can generate an image that isolates the source-of-interest S4. Note that source galaxy 5 lies at the same redshift as S4, hence the extra arc to the southeast and image to the southwest within the cutout; we simply mask out these images in our modeling scheme. We also introduce the same labeling of the S4 lensed images as the Carousel Lens Papers 41 , 31 , and 51 .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：旋转木马透镜的VLT/MUSE图像。左图：全白光线图像，通过沿光谱轴聚合数据立方生成。此处标注了最显著的星系团成员，其中\(L_{e}\)位于图像裁剪区域之外。这与成像数据通常观测到的结果类似。右图：通过聚焦于\(z_{s}=1.432\)处的[O II]发射并利用帧内其他源的连续谱，我们可以生成一幅隔离目标源S4的图像。注意源星系5与S4位于同一红移，因此裁剪区域内东南方向有额外弧线，西南方向有额外图像；我们在建模方案中简单地将这些图像掩蔽。我们还引入了与旋转木马透镜论文41、31和51相同的S4透镜图像标记。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: A static presentation of the continuum-subtracted datacube, specifically image \(4d\) (the southern-most image in Figure 1 ). Left panels: the image at different spectral slices of the datacube. Right panel: the large aperture spectrum of S4, plotted alongside the double Gaussian fit in our datacube modeling. The red dotted lines indicate the wavelength slices 1 (9070.06Å), 2 (9072.56Å), and 3 (9075.06Å) to which the left panel slices correspond. From the left panels, we clearly see that the emission of S4 shifts from east to west with increasing wavelength, indicating a strong rotation present. For a full non-static presentation of the datacube, see here: https://portal.nersc.gov/cfs/deepsrch/IFUL/figure2.gif .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：连续谱扣除数据立方的静态展示，具体为图像\(4d\)（图1中最南端的图像）。左图：数据立方不同光谱切片处的图像。右图：S4的大孔径光谱，与数据立方建模中的双高斯拟合一同绘制。红色虚线表示左图切片对应的波长切片1（9070.06Å）、2（9072.56Å）和3（9075.06Å）。从左图可以清楚地看到，随着波长增加，S4的发射从东向西移动，表明存在强旋转。关于数据立方的完整非静态展示，请参见：https://portal.nersc.gov/cfs/deepsrch/IFUL/figure2.gif。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: The initial, best-fitting flat model using lenstronomy assuming a single Sérsic light profile for the source galaxy, using the continuum-subtracted emission line map. This fit serves as an initial parameterization for our datacube reconstruction. See Section 4.1 for the full model design. Top left: the continuum-subtracted emission line map. Top middle: the reconstructed lenstronomy image. Top right: the normalized residuals between the two. Bottom left: the source light profile on the lens plane, with the lensing caustics overlaid in yellow. Bottom middle: the modeled convergence profile. Bottom right: the image-plane magnification profile. As expected, there are strong residuals due to the simplicity of the modeled source galaxy light profile, but nevertheless the image positions are well recovered.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：使用lenstronomy的初始最佳拟合平坦模型，假设源星系为单一Sérsic光轮廓，使用连续谱扣除的发射线图。该拟合作为我们数据立方重建的初始参数化。完整模型设计见第4.1节。左上：连续谱扣除的发射线图。中上：重建的lenstronomy图像。右上：两者之间的归一化残差。左下：透镜平面上的源光轮廓，黄色叠加透镜焦散线。中下：建模的收敛轮廓。右下：像平面放大率轮廓。如预期，由于建模的源星系光轮廓过于简单，存在强残差，但图像位置仍得到良好恢复。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: A static presentation of the best-fit datacube model and its comparison to the continuum-subtracted datacube. Each row represents a specific wavelength slice of the datacube, with the wavelength labeling provided in Figure 2 . Left: the continuum-subtracted datacube slice at the indicated wavelength. Middle: the corresponding modeled datacube slice. Right: the normalized residuals between the two. For a full non-static presentation of the best-fitting datacube model, see here: https://portal.nersc.gov/cfs/deepsrch/IFUL/figure4.gif .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：最佳拟合数据立方模型的静态展示及其与连续谱扣除数据立方的比较。每行代表数据立方的特定波长切片，波长标记见图2。左：指定波长处的连续谱扣除数据立方切片。中：相应的建模数据立方切片。右：两者之间的归一化残差。关于最佳拟合数据立方模型的完整非静态展示，请参见：https://portal.nersc.gov/cfs/deepsrch/IFUL/figure4.gif。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: The resulting posterior distributions for a subset of lensing parameters shared by the different modeling schemes. The three models are (1) a flat, image-based model using lenstronomy with a single Sérsic source, (2) a flat, image-based model using lenstronomy with a single Sérsic source and an \(n_{max}=4\) shapelets basis, and (3) a datacube-based model using IFUL (see Section 4 for the full details). All angle quantities are given as East of North. Constraints are significantly tighter across the common parameters when incorporating the source kinematic information into the lens model.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：不同建模方案共享的透镜参数子集的后验分布结果。三个模型为：（1）使用lenstronomy的平坦、基于图像的模型，单一Sérsic源；（2）使用lenstronomy的平坦、基于图像的模型，单一Sérsic源和\(n_{max}=4\)形状基；（3）使用IFUL的基于数据立方的模型（完整细节见第4节）。所有角度量均以东北向给出。当将源运动学信息纳入透镜模型时，共同参数的约束显著收紧。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: RGB image representations of the continuum-subtracted and the modeled datacubes. The red, green, and blue channels correspond to the wavelength slices 1 (9070.06Å), 2 (9072.56Å), and 3 (9075.06Å) in Figures 2 and 4 .
figures.caption_zh: 图5：连续谱扣除数据立方和建模数据立方的RGB图像表示。红、绿、蓝通道分别对应图2和图4中的波长切片1（9070.06Å）、2（9072.56Å）和3（9075.06Å）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: The best-fit source-plane kinematics of S4. Left: the line-of-sight velocity \(v_{LOS}\) profile. Middle: the velocity dispersion \(\sigma_{v}\) profile. Right: the discretized logarithmic source surface-brightness profile.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：S4的最佳拟合源平面运动学。左：沿视线速度\(v_{LOS}\)轮廓。中：速度弥散\(\sigma_{v}\)轮廓。右：离散化对数源表面亮度轮廓。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Corner plot comparison between three different modeling approaches (see Table 1 and Section 5.1 ). We show the Einstein radius \(\theta_{E}\) , logarithmic slope \(\gamma\) , the semi-major to minor axis ratio \(q_{m}\) , and the position angle \(\phi_{m}\) of the power-law profile describing the primary deflector convergence profile.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：三种不同建模方法之间的角图比较（见表1和第5.1节）。我们展示了描述主偏转器收敛轮廓的幂律剖面的爱因斯坦半径\(\theta_{E}\)、对数斜率\(\gamma\)、长短轴比\(q_{m}\)和位置角\(\phi_{m}\)。

title: A GLIMPSE of Dark Matter: JWST Constraints on Early Structure Formation
summary: While we have a solid understanding of how dark matter (DM) behaves during recombination ($z\sim 10^3$) and in the late universe ($z\lesssim$ a few), much less is known about intermediate times, when the first galaxies formed. These galaxies provide a powerful handle on DM through structure formation, as halos have to exist to host luminous sources. Here we use recent determinations of the UV luminosity function from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) GLIMPSE lensing program, along with legacy Hubble and Subaru data, to test the small-scale behavior of DM during the epoch of reionization ($z\sim 7$). Marginalizing over astrophysical uncertainties, we find the matter power spectrum to be consistent with the cold-DM prediction down to sub-Mpc scales, with 1$σ$ uncertainties of 0.2 dex at $k=3-9 \, \rm Mpc^{-1}$ and 0.5 dex at $k=9-27 \, \rm Mpc^{-1}$, the smallest scales probed at these early times. For thermal-relic warm DM we constrain $m_{\rm WDM} > 3.2\, \rm keV$ (95% CL), independent of lower-$z$ probes. Our results test small-scale structure formation in a new redshift window and demonstrate the promise of JWST to constrain the nature of DM.

AI.tldr: 利用JWST GLIMPSE引力透镜计划的UV光度函数及HST、Subaru数据，在再电离时期（z~7）检验暗物质小尺度行为，发现物质功率谱在亚Mpc尺度与冷暗物质预言一致，并对热遗迹温暗物质给出m_WDM > 3.2 keV（95% CL）的下限。
AI.motivation: 暗物质在复合时期（z~10^3）和晚期宇宙（z≲几）的行为已有较好认识，但对第一批星系形成的中间时期（再电离时期）了解甚少。高红移星系可作为暗物质的有力探针，因为发光源的存在要求其宿主暗物质晕必须存在，从而可反推小尺度结构形成情况。
AI.method: 结合JWST GLIMPSE引力透镜计划最新测定的UV光度函数与Hubble、Subaru的遗留数据，在z~7检验暗物质的小尺度行为；通过对天体物理不确定性进行边缘化处理，将观测与冷暗物质及热遗迹温暗物质模型预言的物质功率谱进行对比。
AI.result: 物质功率谱在亚Mpc尺度与冷暗物质预言一致，k=3–9 Mpc^-1处1σ不确定度为0.2 dex，k=9–27 Mpc^-1处为0.5 dex，这是该早期时期探测到的最小尺度。对热遗迹温暗物质，得到m_WDM > 3.2 keV（95% CL），且独立于低红移探针。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在一个新的红移窗口检验了小尺度结构形成，并展示了JWST在约束暗物质本质方面的潜力。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 尽管我们对暗物质（DM）在复合时期（$z\sim 10^3$）和晚期宇宙（$z\lesssim$ 几个）的行为有扎实的理解，但对中间时期——第一批星系形成时——的了解却少得多。这些星系通过结构形成提供了对暗物质的有力约束，因为必须存在晕来容纳发光源。在这里，我们利用詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）GLIMPSE透镜计划对UV光度函数的最新测定，以及哈勃和Subaru的遗留数据，来检验再电离时期（$z\sim 7$）暗物质的小尺度行为。在边缘化天体物理不确定性后，我们发现物质功率谱在亚Mpc尺度上与冷暗物质预测一致，在$k=3-9 \, \rm Mpc^{-1}$处1$σ$不确定性为0.2 dex，在$k=9-27 \, \rm Mpc^{-1}$处为0.5 dex，这是在这些早期时间探测到的最小尺度。对于热遗迹温暗物质，我们得到$m_{\rm WDM} > 3.2\, \rm keV$（95% CL），独立于低$z$探测。我们的结果在一个新的红移窗口检验了小尺度结构形成，并展示了JWST在约束暗物质本质方面的潜力。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：该工作在一个新的红移窗口检验了小尺度结构形成，并展示了JWST在约束暗物质本质方面的潜力。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: The matter power spectrum \(P(k)\) linearly extrapolated to \(z=0\) . Black line is the CDM prediction and red dashed is WDM with \(m_{WDM}=3.2\) keV (at our 95% CL). Colored circles show measurements from different probes [ 33 , 5 , 111 , 91 , 2 ] , and vertical green-dotted lines correspond to the non-linear scale (defined as \(k_{NL}=1/R_{NL}\) for the radius \(R_{NL}\) that has unit variance) at \(z\sim 0,~4\) and \(7\) . Our results are shown as black squares, which reach comparable scales to strong lensing [ 51 , purple region] but at higher \(z\) , and smaller scales (higher \(k\) , smaller halo masses on the top axis) than past UVLF work with HST [ 95 , gray] .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：线性外推至\(z=0\)的物质功率谱\(P(k)\)。黑线是CDM预测，红色虚线是\(m_{WDM}=3.2\) keV的WDM（在我们的95% CL处）。彩色圆圈显示了来自不同探测的测量[33,5,111,91,2]，垂直绿色点线对应于\(z\sim 0,~4\)和\(7\)处的非线性尺度（定义为\(k_{NL}=1/R_{NL}\)，其中半径\(R_{NL}\)具有单位方差）。我们的结果显示为黑色方块，其达到的尺度与强透镜[51，紫色区域]相当，但红移更高，且尺度更小（更高的\(k\)，顶部轴上更小的晕质量）比过去使用HST的UVLF工作[95，灰色]。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: UVLF at \(z\sim 7\) predicted within CDM (solid), WDM (with \(m_{WDM}=3.2\) keV, red dashed), and a model with a 2 \(\times\) reduction in power for \(k\geq 9\,{Mpc}^{-1}\) (orange dotted), alongside data from HST-blank fields (yellow circles), HST-lens (blue squares), and JWST’s GLIMPSE (green diamonds). The depth of GLIMPSE allows us to better constrain small-scale structure and thus deviations from CDM.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：在CDM（实线）、WDM（\(m_{WDM}=3.2\) keV，红色虚线）以及一个在\(k\geq 9\,{Mpc}^{-1}\)处功率降低2\(\times\)的模型（橙色点线）中预测的\(z\sim 7\)处的UVLF，同时展示了来自HST空白场（黄色圆圈）、HST透镜（蓝色方块）和JWST的GLIMPSE（绿色菱形）的数据。GLIMPSE的深度使我们能够更好地约束小尺度结构，从而约束对CDM的偏离。

title: Identifying Scientifically Interesting Galaxies with Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to the Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences Workshop (ML4PS 2026)
summary: Anomaly searches in large astronomical image datasets aim to identify rare objects for follow-up investigation. Yet the objects that are most statistically unusual are not necessarily those of greatest scientific relevance. We investigate whether pretrained vision-language models can directly assess scientific interest from natural-language instructions, enabling galaxy images to be ranked without labeled examples. We evaluate models on a 20,000-image Hubble Space Telescope sample that includes 167 reference anomalies previously identified through machine learning and expert inspection. By scoring images for scientific interest, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite places 98.2% of the reference anomalies within the highest-ranked ~2,000 images, at a present-day inference cost of approximately $5.05 per 10,000 images. We recover known gravitational lenses, jellyfish-galaxy candidates, and galaxies with visible jets, and release 102 high-scoring candidates for further investigation. These results show that an off-the-shelf vision-language model, without any training on the target data, offers a practical way to rank large image datasets by scientific relevance rather than rarity. The project code is available at https://github.com/TheCheng2005/Galaxy-Anomaly-Search/
